title: Delphi research result
description: What `research_result` returns to a host agent (specs/066 §4; crates/delphi-core/src/research.rs). A claim's `knowledge_status` is never raised by its source being trusted (specs/052).

answer.description: Model synthesis, labelled not validated. Raw page text is never returned.

new_claims.description: Deduplicated staged candidates, not search hits.

corroboration_pass.description: The corroboration pass of a survey or deep run (specs/098 section 7.5 item 5): how many public claims it looked for more support for, and how many queries it sent. A claim resting on a private source is never queried.

coverage.description: `thin` when the knowledge base and the trusted sources together gave fewer kept, cited claims than `[research] thin_below` (specs/098 section 7.5).

coverage_report.description: What each rung of the source ladder (specs/098 section 7.1) turned up and kept. A `reason` appears only on a rung that was searched and found nothing, or cannot be reached from inside; it is one word of a fixed list and never provider text.

counted.description: Kept, cited claims from the knowledge base and the trusted sources, after dedupe.

host_rungs.description: When thin: the rungs the host's own tools and connectors can take over.

leads_kept.description: Search results the fetcher would not reach, kept as noted leads.

search_log.description: Present only when `[research] search_log` is on (specs/101 section 3): a summary of, and a link to, the top-level `search_log`.

signature.description: The identity line in the form chosen by [mcp] badge_style: the same string as `display`, kept for hosts that read it.

display.description: The one line a host prints first (specs/087 section 5.2): the badge, the name and `(role, via delphi)`, in the form [mcp] badge_style names and, for ansi, the colour pair [mcp] badge_mode names. On a Council result it is followed by the ruling card.

boundary_line.description: Advice: `── Name (role) takes over: reason ──`, for when the speaker changes (specs/087 section 5.4). A host may drop it.

return_line.description: Advice: the matching line for when control comes back.

search_log.description: What the run searched, of whom, when, and how much came back (specs/101 section 3). Written by the daemon: a host cannot add, edit or delete a line. It is private when any claim it served is, and a private log never leaves the install. It is information; nothing reads it as a reason to trust, promote or permit anything.

search_line.description: One search. `query` is the same redacted string that was sent; a search withheld because its claim rests on a private source has `withheld: private` and no `query`. Every line the daemon ran balances: hits = duplicates + kept + the sum of not_kept.

source.description: Of whom: the knowledge base, the operator's trusted list, a host tool the host declared, or a provider. doi, archive and citation are reserved for later slices of spec 101.

via.description: The provider that answered a trusted-list search.

failed.description: The search itself failed, in one word of the fixed list.

declared.description: Reported by the host, not made by the daemon. Its kept is 0 and it counts as nothing.

search_flow.description: The lines the daemon ran, summed (a declared line and the knowledge-base line are not in it): found = duplicates_removed + kept + the sum of not_kept.

knowledge_status.description: `corroborated`: three or more independent origins state it, counted by code (specs/098 section 7.6). Weaker than `validated`; it raises nothing else and is never read as a reason to trust or permit anything.

corroboration.description: How many independent origins state the claim and how many of them are trusted sources (the operator's list inside its topic scope, or a Primary or Reputable class). Display only: it changes no status, taint, tier or queue order.

from_trusted_source.description: Provenance only; does not change knowledge_status.

hex_light.description: The colour for a light terminal (specs/087 section 5.1).

via.description: Present when a host adopted the role. It does not change how the identity reads: the line always ends `, via delphi)` (specs/087 section 5.3).
